event.description: Removed LayerNorm affine scale and bias in both transformer blocks and the final normalization, retaining d=16 and ff=40.
event.proposal: Parameterization-preserving compression hypothesis: the fixed normalization statistics are sufficient for this narrow, fixed-format task, making the learned per-channel LayerNorm scale and shift redundant; remove all five affine LayerNorm parameter pairs while preserving normalization and the accepted architecture.
